description: HTTP security headers audit / scanner for up to 5 URLs or domains: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors (clickjacking), X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff), Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP, cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; names only), HTTPS redirect and server version disclosure.
